## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] For visible changes: browser flows and the AAA matrix pass (`node tests/browser/run.mjs --only flows,aaa`), and I looked at the screenshots
- [ ] Texts are in every locale, in plain language (no em dashes, emojis or stock phrases)
- [ ] Music facts checked (note names, staff positions, key signatures)
- [ ] No new runtime dependency or request to another origin
- [ ] For a piece: the melody is public domain and the transcription is my own
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under Unreleased (for user-visible changes)
